fidelity: F2a — Lumped-Capacitance Dynamic Energy Balance ODE
source: Duffie & Beckman (2013) 'Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes', 4th ed., Wiley, Ch.6 & Ch.10; EN 12975 / ISO 9806:2017 quasi-dynamic test method; SRCC OG-100 certified ETC ratings

unit.name: Generic 30-tube Evacuated Tube Collector (Apricus AP-30 style) — physics-lumped

optical_eff.note: Zero-loss optical efficiency eta_0 = (tau*alpha)_eff at normal incidence; equals F1 eta_0. Fraction of incident beam absorbed by selective absorber.

emissivity.note: Hemispherical emissivity of selective absorber coating (e.g. sputtered AlN/Al cermet). Low-e drives radiation-dominated loss in evacuated annulus.

absorber_area_ratio.note: Ratio of absorber radiating area to gross aperture area (cylindrical absorber tubes vs flat aperture).

U_residual.note: Residual non-radiative conduction loss coefficient: end-cap / header conduction + residual gas conduction in the vacuum annulus. Small because vacuum suppresses convection. Duffie & Beckman Ch.6; SRCC ETC data.

b0.note: Incidence angle modifier coefficient (Duffie & Beckman Eq. 6.17.6) for tubular geometry.

C_thermal.note: Lumped thermal capacitance of absorber + manifold fluid (effective heat capacity). EN 12975 effective thermal capacity ~5-7 kJ/m2K * area + fluid hold-up.

T_inlet.note: ETCs operate at higher T than flat plate
